`feature`, `spike` and `bug` `complete` refused whenever any tracked file in the scanned worktree had uncommitted changes, even a file unrelated to the item. The gate now blocks only on files that belong to the item.

- Own files = files of the item's linked commits, plus (in a linked worktree) the existing GH-#161 branch diff. Matched by exact repo-relative path.
